cell.display_name: LG M50 | O'Regan2022 characterization and model
cell.model_context: Experimental tables and separately labeled published DFN/SPM/SPMe model inputs
cell.match_evidence: Parameter tables and published model refer to LG M50. OCP functions are borrowed from Chen2020. TEC/Chen full-cell comparisons are separate studies; same serialized specimens are not established.

coverage.ocp: Two stored Chen2020 expressions explicitly reused by O'Regan; no new measured OCP table in this deposit.
coverage.diffusion: 40 experimental tables: two electrodes, two specimens, five temperatures, two directions; plus two separately labeled model laws and a borrowed electrolyte law.
coverage.kinetics: Eight experimental i0 tables at 15/25/35/45 C; two separate concentration/temperature model laws and source charge-transfer/double-layer inputs.
coverage.full_cell_tests: External same-model Chen/TEC discovery links only; no same-specimen assertion or new full-cell payload.

cell.note: Do not merge experimental-table and published-model variants automatically; M50, M50T and M50LT are distinct identities.

quarantined_source_files.reason: Header claims J kg-1 K-1, but sign and magnitude are inconsistent with a physical specific heat capacity. No undocumented correction or substitution.
